When you gain an {u}{b}{c_important}Attunement{/c}{/b}{/u} level in the {c_important}Undercity{/c}, {c_important}Experience Orbs{/c} appear around you.

All enemies within the {c_important}Undercity{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

{icon:Marker_Season_Green_font,2.5}At Rank {c_number}4{/c} with the {c_important}Splinter of Destruction{/c}, you gain {c_number}50%{/c} more {c_important}Experience Orbs{/c} and {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u} is increased by +{c_number}1{/c} more.
